$description: Variables that exist in Figma (read via Plugin API on 2026-11-02) but are missing from their collection's variable list, so Token Exporter skips them. Without them, these aliases break: text/on-primary (Light) and layout/grid/columns. Remove an entry once the variable is fixed in Figma and shows up in the export.

$retype.why: Token Exporter emits these FLOAT variables as unitless numbers, but in Figma they are pixel line heights (text styles use 112px, 104px, …). Unitless in CSS would mean a multiplier.
